plain_what: A recurrent layer keeps a running memory and decides at each step how fast old content fades and how much new input enters. The old recipe used smooth curves (sigmoid, exponential, tanh). The replacement opens the input with a clamped straight line, picks the fade rate from a short table of powers of two, and carries state by rotation.
how_it_works: The trunk's sequence mixer is a recurrence over quaternion lanes: h_t = q_t (x) h_{t-1} + b_t, evaluated by quaternion_scan, with q_t a decay-scaled unit quaternion and b_t the convolved drive. Four squashing sites in the historical form (a sigmoid opening, an exp/softplus decay rate, a tanh-GELU output gate) are replaced in rec_gates=geometric mode. (1) Opening: score = clamp(gate opening + rec.decay, 0, 1), exact subgradient; the per-lane decay parameter is read raw, with no softplus. (2) Rate: rate_select picks one of 16 table entries by threshold on the score; lambda = 2^-(s+1), an exact f32 power of two, with keep = sqrt(1 - lambda^2) precomputed in a second table, so |keep^2 + lambda^2 - 1| <= 6e-8 and serving needs only table reads. (3) Carry: the unchanged quaternion scan. (4) Output gate: the Hamilton rotation gate (see hamilton-gate) on the recurrence output. Because hard selection has zero derivative, the backward uses a declared geometric secant surrogate: pair the incoming adjoints (d lambda, d keep) with the selected entry's neighbours' full counterfactual table displacement and resolve the contrast along the fixed edge 1/16, half per side, whole weight to the single neighbour at either end. No probability or exponential is involved. The geometric mode refuses non-CUDA devices, export and qat; the historical mode stays the default so old artifacts reproduce.
geometry: Unit-quaternion transport on S3 lanes (Hamilton product, rotation of R4 blocks); an exact dyadic table; the Hamilton rotation gate. Related finite-group (binary icosahedral 2I) lanes were studied separately.

rule_compat.D11: Designed for it: rate and keep are exact f32 powers of two read from a table, the opening is clamped-linear and the scan is Hamilton products. Not yet exportable: the integer engine binds the historical decay parameter, so export and qat refuse the mode; the Hamilton output gate still needs the icosian snap.
rule_compat.D23: Verified by grep on 13 Oct: 0 squash-family tokens in the geometric decay arm, output-gate arm, rate_select host op and its CUDA kernels (the historical branches keep 8 by design). The read path's exp is untouched and out of scope for the recurrence-only rung 0.
rule_compat.D30: No dense contraction and no softmax: a clamp, a table read, the scan and a per-block rotation. no_matmul ratchet 93/93 and no_softmax ratchet 1649/1649 were unchanged by the delivering PR.
rule_compat.D32_D37: A float operator; D32 section 4 froze it, D37 section 5 allows it back by re-registration only. The active discrete model carries no recurrent state, so this belongs to a separate float trunk.

failed_only_on_configuration: Dense ternary recurrence saturation: an unbounded dense state; says nothing about a bounded, gated, rotating one.
Gated-delta smoke lost to plain delta on a 28-event synthetic fixture whose read key came from the last context only; the hierarchy-fed rung was never built.
Quantization-aware and projected continuation (rung 2): tests a quantization recipe on the continuous learner, not the dyadic rate table.
Quaternion arm no better than Householder at one paired seed: not a transport negative, since identity transport is clearly worse (D1: 0.07 nats).
B1 lanes: the A5 tracking skill belongs to the finite group; the Stage B text gate failure is about mixing synthetic words into text training.
Shipped Bott-Fock fold retained 16% of the long-range ceiling: the constant, not the idea of decay, was wrong.
open_questions: Do hard-selected rates train stably under a secant credit, or does the table plateau (the last four keep entries sit at the f32 plateau of 1)?
Does rotation (quaternion) beat reflection (Householder pair) as the state-carry at scale and under a finite-precision export?
Is a recurrence the right sequence mixer for the geometric model at all now that the active discrete model reads context through Route/Flock?
What does the export gap look like when rate scores are bound into the integer engine?

figure_ideas: A staircase plot of the 16 table rates lambda = 2^-(s+1) against the opening score in [0,1], laid over the smooth sigmoid/exp curve it replaces; mark the selected entry and its two neighbours that the secant credit compares.

A set of quaternion lanes drawn as arrows rotating each step: the arrow turns by q_t and shrinks by the chosen lambda, with keep = sqrt(1 - lambda^2) shown as the fraction of the old state kept, so lambda^2 + keep^2 = 1 appears as a unit-circle triangle.

A retention curve for a single remembered token over 32 steps for several table rates, each a clean power of two, next to the historical continuous decay: shows the bank of fixed clocks the table provides.
